This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Pokeball arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, Pokeball has been observed to be fearful and avoidant of handlers. During his assessment, Pokeball was noted to retreat and hide behind the secondary handler when the primary handler attempted to place a collar on him. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult-only home.
dog.name: Pokeball
